outlooks.summary: A SQUALL LINE CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS WILL MOVE ACROSS THE ARKLATEX REGION AND INTO THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE PRIMARILY ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY DURING THE DAY AND A SEVERE RISK WILL LIKELY LINGER INTO TONIGHT NEAR THE CENTRAL GULF COAST.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INTENSE MID- TO UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS THIS MORNING WILL MOVE E AND NE DURING THE PERIOD AS A SURFACE CYCLONE DEVELOPS NEWD FROM THE CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE MID MO VALLEY. A COLD FRONT WILL PUSH EWD ACROSS THE ERN PORTIONS OF OK/TX INTO AR DURING THE DAY WHILE A MARITIME WARM FRONT ADVANCES NWD THROUGH A LARGE PORTION OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: E TX/OK THRU THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A QLCS EXTENDING FROM THE LOWER PLAINS SWD INTO E-CNTRL TX WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING AT THE START OF THE DAY 1 PERIOD. ISOLD DMGG WINDS WILL BE THE PREDOMINANT RISK ALONG THE SQUALL LINE BUT A FEW TORNADOES MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY ANY LONGER-LIVED CIRCULATIONS EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE AS IT MOVES EWD TOWARDS THE OZARK PLATEAU SWD INTO E TX AND THE ARKLATEX REGION. MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION WILL PROBABLY OCCUR AHEAD OF THE EXPANSIVE CONVECTIVE LINE AIDED PARTIALLY BY A STRONG POLEWARD FLUX OF A MODIFIED/VERY MOIST AIRMASS OVER COASTAL TX/LA/MS MOVING NWD INTO MUCH OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY. IN ADDITION TO THE RISK OF WIND DAMAGE ACCOMPANYING THE LINE...MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THE POSSIBILITY FOR QUASI-DISCRETE STORMS TO DEVELOP WITH A STRONG BELT OF 55+ KT H85 FLOW OVER THE MS VALLEY DURING THE AFTERNOON. DESPITE MEAGER LAPSE RATE PROFILES...LARGE HODOGRAPHS WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADIC SUPERCELLS. BY EVENING...A GRADUAL PINCHING OF THE WARM SECTOR WILL LIKELY OCCUR AS THE LARGEST MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA SHIFT NEWD AWAY FROM THE CNTRL GULF COAST WHICH WILL CORRESPOND TO THE REMAINING SEVERE THREAT BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONFINED

outlooks.summary: A SQUALL LINE CAPABLE OF ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS WILL MOVE ACROSS THE ARKLATEX REGION AND INTO THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. THE AREA OF GREATEST CONCERN FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES IS OVER PARTS OF ARKANSAS AND LOUISIANA. MORNING RADAR LOOP SHOWS A SQUALL LINE EXTENDING FROM SOUTHWEST MO INTO EAST-CENTRAL TX. THIS LINE WILL TRACK EASTWARD TODAY ACROSS MUCH OF MO/AR/LA AND EVENTUALLY INTO WESTERN TN/MS TONIGHT. VERY STRONG SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE PRESENT ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY...WHICH WILL MAINTAIN SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S TO NEAR 70F TODAY. CONSIDERABLE CLOUD COVER IS EXPECTED AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE...BUT THERE APPEARS TO BE A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR SOME DAYTIME HEATING/DESTABILIZATION OVER EASTERN AR/NORTHERN LA DURING THE EARLY/MID AFTERNOON. SEVERAL OVERNIGHT CAM SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THIS AREA WILL SEE A PERIOD OF DISCRETE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE...WHERE AN ENHANCED RISK OF A FEW TORNADOES IS FORECAST. OTHERWISE...THE PRIMARY RISK THROUGHOUT THE DAY WILL BE EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES ALONG THE SQUALL LINE PRODUCING LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS BRIEF QLCS TORNADOES. A SQUALL LINE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL MOVE ACROSS THE ARKLATEX REGION AND THROUGH THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. THE AREA OF GREATEST CONCERN FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES IS OVER PARTS OF ARKANSAS AND LOUISIANA AND WESTERN MISSISSIPPI THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INTENSE MID-LEVEL LOW OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS WILL PIVOT NEWD INTO ERN PORTIONS OF NEB AND KS WHILE AN ATTENDANT 100+ KT JET STREAK AT 500 MB ADVANCES FROM THE CNTRL AND SRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE MS VALLEY. AT THE SURFACE...A PACIFIC FRONT PRESENTLY STRETCHING FROM AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE OVER CNTRL KS SSEWD INTO CNTRL TX WILL PROGRESS EWD TOWARD THE MIDDLE AND LOWER MS VALLEYS. MEANWHILE THE KS SURFACE LOW WILL FURTHER DEEPEN AND SUBSEQUENTLY UNDERGO OCCLUSION AS IT ACCELERATES NNEWD INTO THE UPPER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: OZARK PLATEAU INTO ERN TX AND EWD INTO THE CNTRL GULF STATES
sections.text: A WIDESPREAD AREA OF PRE-FRONTAL SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING AS OF MID MORNING FROM THE OZARK PLATEAU INTO ERN TX...DRIVEN HEAT AND MOISTURE FLUXES ALONG A 50-60+ KT SLY LLJ AND THE LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA PRECEDING THE SRN PLAINS UPPER LOW. THESE SAME FORCING MECHANISMS WILL GRADUALLY SHIFT EWD TOWARD THE MS VALLEY TODAY...COMBINING WITH THE CONTINUED INFLUX OF A VERY MOIST AIR MASS FROM OFF THE GULF OF MEXICO AND FILTERED SUNSHINE TO SUPPORT THE GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE WIDESPREAD MORNING CONVECTION. GIVEN THE CO-LOCATION OF A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH STRONG LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...THE POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR EMBEDDED SUPERCELL AND LEWP STRUCTURES WITH AN ASSOCIATED RISK FOR DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES. ADDITIONALLY...VARIOUS CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL BANDS OF SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS FORMING THIS AFTERNOON ALONG CONFLUENCE ZONES OVER ERN PORTIONS OF LA AND AR INTO WRN MS...AHEAD OF THE MAIN QLCS. SHOULD THIS SCENARIO UNFOLD AS FORECAST...A MORE SUBSTANTIAL TORNADO THREAT WOULD EXIST AND THIS IS ADDRESSED WITH THE 10 PERC

outlooks.summary: A SQUALL LINE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL MOVE ACROSS THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND NORTHWEST GULF COAST. THE AREA OF GREATEST CONCERN FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES IS OVER PARTS OF ARKANSAS AND LOUISIANA AND WESTERN MISSISSIPPI THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: OZARK PLATEAU AND EAST TX TO CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: THE FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU TO THE NORTHWEST GULF COAST AND EASTWARD TO THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT. THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL REMAIN ATTENDANT TO THE EASTWARD-MOVING PRE-FRONTAL SQUALL LINE...WHICH AT 1930Z EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL AR SOUTHWESTWARD THROUGH NORTHERN LA TO THE UPPER TX COAST. THE POLEWARD MOISTURE RETURN HAS RESULTED IN SURFACE DEW POINTS AROUND 70 F IN SOUTHEAST AR AND WEST-CENTRAL MS COMBINED WITH FILTERED SUNSHINE TO AID IN MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG ACROSS MUCH OF THE ENH RISK AREA AND SOUTHERN HALF OF THE SLGT RISK AREA. ONGOING STABILIZATION WITH THE PASSAGE OF THE SQUALL LINE HAS RESULTED IN A DIMINISHED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WITH WESTWARD EXTENT. THIS TREND WILL PERSIST WITH THE PASSAGE OF THE LINE OF STORMS...AND HAS BEEN INDICATED BY TRIMMING THE WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE SEVERE PROBABILITIES AND CATEGORICAL RISK AREAS WITH THIS OUTLOOK ISSUANCE.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: THE GENERAL TSTM LINE HAS BEEN ADJUSTED FOR LIGHTNING TRENDS ALONG THE PRIMARY COLD FRONT AS IT ADVANCES ACROSS CENTRAL TX...AND ALSO FOR RECENT STRIKES ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO. ..PETERS.. 11/17/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1026 AM CST TUE NOV 17 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOSAIC RADAR DATA INDICATE EXTENSIVE TSTM ACTIVITY PRESENT AS OF 14Z AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT PUSHING THROUGH ERN TX. DESPITE WIDESPREAD CLOUDS...12Z RAOBS AND CURRENT WSR-88D VAD DATA INDICATE A VERY MOIST AND ALREADY MODERATELY UNSTABLE /I.E. MLCAPE OF AROUND 1000 J PER KG/ AIR MASS WHICH COINCIDES WITH A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT FEATURING A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH RELATIVELY STRONG LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR. AS SUCH...THE SETUP WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF A FEW TORNADOES AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. THIS IS ESPECIALLY THE CASE LATER THIS MORNING AS FILTERED SUNSHINE FURTHER WARMS/DESTABILIZES THE BOUNDARY LAYER. ..MEAD.. 11/17/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT ACROSS WW 544 IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE LATE THIS MORNING INTO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON. A NEW WW TO THE EAST OF WW 544 WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO THE 18Z EXPIRATION TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT LOCATED FROM ERN OK SWD INTO EAST TX ALONG WHICH A MULTI-SEGMENTED LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. SFC WINDS ARE SOUTHEASTERLY AHEAD OF THE STORMS WITH A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EXTENDING FROM NRN LA NWD ACROSS AR INTO SRN MO. SFC DEWPOINTS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR ARE IN THE 65 TO 70 F RANGE WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED BY MESOANALYSIS DATA IN THE 200 TO 500 J/KG RANGE. IN SPITE OF THE WEAK INSTABILITY...THE WSR-88D VWP AT LITTLE ROCK SHOWS AN IMPRESSIVE WIND PROFILE WITH 0-1 KM SHEAR OF 45 TO 50 KT. THUNDERSTORMS THAT CAN ORGANIZE IN THE STRONGLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE ABLE TO PUSH THE STRONGER WINDS TO THE SFC...RESULTING IN A WIND DAMAGE THREAT. AS ROTATING CELLS OR BOW ECHOES DEVELOP ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT EARLY THIS AFTERNOON...AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. BECAUSE A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED...WW ISSUANCE TO THE EAST OF WW 544 WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 18Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR WIND DAMAGE AND TORNADOES IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST OF WW 545.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT FROM CNTRL AR EXTENDING SWD ACROSS NW LA INTO SE TX...ALONG WHICH A LARGE-SCALE BOWING LINE SEGMENT IS ONGOING. SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE LINE ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 500 TO 1000 J/KG AS IS ESTIMATED BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS. INSTABILITY SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS THE MCD AREA OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS SFC HEATING AND MOISTURE ADVECTION TAKES PLACE. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE DUE TO THE APPROACH OF A SRN PLAINS UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH. THIS ALONG WITH INCREASING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT SHOULD ENABLE THE LINE OF STORMS TO BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED THIS AFTERNOON. IN ADDITION...REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOW STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES WHICH WILL MAKE STORM ROTATION LIKELY WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE. DISCRETE CELLS AHEAD OF THE LINE WILL ALSO ROTATE. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN A TORNADO THREAT AS THE LINE GRADUALLY MOVES EWD. WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH BOWING LINE SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE IS EXPECTED TO EXPAND EWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW 546 IN CNTRL AND ERN AR THIS AFTERNOON. THE THREAT SHOULD AFFECT NW MS AND WRN TN LATER THIS AFTERNOON WHERE AN ADDITIONAL WW MAY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT FROM NEAR LITTLE ROCK EXTENDING SWD INTO NW LA...ALONG WHICH A STRONG LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. AHEAD OF THE LINE ACROSS ERN AR...NW MS AND WRN TN...A MOIST AIRMASS IS IN PLACE WITH SFC DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE 60S F. THIS COMBINED WITH INCREASING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT AND STRONG LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AN APPROACHING UPPER-LEVEL LOW...SHOULD RESULT IN A GRADUAL EXPANSION OF CONVECTIVE COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY IS WEAK AHEAD OF THE LINE...STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS IN PLACE ACROSS THE REGION. THE LITTLE ROCK WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 65 KT WITH VERY STRONG SPEED SHEAR AND SOME DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER. THIS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR ROTATING CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE OR AHEAD OF THE LINE. ROTATING CELLS SHOULD BE ACCOMPANIED WITH A TORNADO THREAT. A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST WITH ROTATING CELLS AND BOWING LINE-SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE WILL CONTINUE ACROSS MUCH OF WRN AND CNTRL LA BEYOND THE 22Z EXPIRATION OF WW 545. FOR THIS REASON...A NEW WW WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE ISSUED FOR PARTS OF LA LATE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT FROM SE AR EXTENDING SSWWD ACROSS WRN LA...ALONG WHICH A LINE OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. THE FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD INTO A VERY MOIST AIRMASS WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOWER 70S F AND SBCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED TO BE FROM 1000 TO 1500 J/KG BY MESOSCALE ANALYSIS DATA. THE LINE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ORGANIZED FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS AS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH APPROACHES FROM THE WEST. AHEAD OF THE LINE...THE LAKE CHARLES WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 65 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH SUBSTANTIAL SPEED SHEAR IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER. THIS SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS WITH THE MORE INTENSE PARTS OF THE LINE THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE AND A COUPLE TORNADOES MAY OCCUR WITH ROTATING CELLS OR BOWING LINE SEGMENTS EMBEDDED IN THE LINE. BECAUSE THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST ACROSS CNTRL AND WRN LA BEYOND THE 22Z WATCH EXPIRATION...A NEW WATCH WILL NEED TO BE ISSUED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT ALONG WITH A POTENTIAL FOR A FEW DAMAGING WING GUSTS MAY PERSIST ACROSS PARTS OF SRN MO AND FAR NE AR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS IS EXPECTED TO BE TOO MARGINAL FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT FROM SCNTRL MO EXTENDING SWD INTO NE AR...ALONG WHICH A LINE OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE LINE IN SE MO AND FAR NE AR ARE GENERALLY IN THE 60 TO 65 F RANGE BUT INSTABILITY IS QUITE WEAK. IN SPITE OF THIS...VERY STRONG WIND FIELDS ARE IN PLACE WHICH MAY RESULT IN ORGANIZATION ALONG THE STRONGER PARTS OF THE LINE. THE ST LOUIS WSR-88D VWP SHOWS STRONG SPEED SHEAR IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER WITH 65 KT OF SLY FLOW AT 1 TO 2 KM AND A 0-1 KM SHEAR NEAR 45 KT. THIS MAY BE ENOUGH FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH ANY CELL THAT CAN EXHIBIT ROTATION ALONG THE LINE LATE THIS AFTERNOON. A TORNADO ALSO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT. DUE TO THE VERY WEAK INSTABILITY...ANY SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN MARGINAL AND WW ISSUANCE APPEARS UNLIKELY THROUGH EARLY THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 548 WITH THE MOST IMMEDIATE THREAT LOCATED ROUGHLY FROM UTA NEWD ALONG THE MS RIVER TO N OF NQA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY HAS SHOWN AN INCREASE IN FORWARD SPEED AND A TRANSITION TO A MORE NEWD MOTION OVER THE PAST HOUR WITH THE PORTION OF THE LINE TO THE SW OF NQA NOW ORIENTED MORE PERPENDICULAR TO THE 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR VECTOR. LOW-LEVEL HELICITY HAS ALSO INCREASE OVER THE PAST HOUR...OWING PRIMARILY TO THE INCREASE SELY SURFACE WINDS. MESOANALYSIS NOW ESTIMATES THE AREA JUST DOWNSTREAM OF THE NEWD SURGING PORTION OF THE LINE -- ROUGHLY FROM UTA NEWD ALONG THE MS RIVER -- HAS 0-1 KM SRH OVER 600 M2/S2. AS A RESULT...THIS AREA CURRENTLY APPEARS TO BE THE MOST FAVORABLE FOR AN IMMEDIATE SVR THREAT WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. A TRANSIENT MESOVORTEX EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LINE IS ALSO POSSIBLE. ..MOSIER.. 11/17/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES MAINLY IN THE EASTERN HALF OF WW #0549. A NEW WATCH WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED TO THE EAST OF THE CURRENT WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SOMEWHAT LOOSELY ORGANIZED QLCS CONTINUES TO PUSH EAST ACROSS THE WW. DESPITE A HIGHLY-SHEARED AND VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 500-1500 J/KG RANGE...A LINE ORIENTATION MOSTLY PARALLEL TO THE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS MAINTAINING A SLOW MOVING CONVECTIVE LINE RELATIVE TO THE STRENGTH OF THE LOW- TO MID-LEVEL WIND SPEEDS. GIVEN THE NEARLY SATURATED PROFILES UP TO NEARLY 700 MB...PRODUCTION OF SEVERE WINDS IS PREDICATED ON PORTIONS OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE GAINING AN ORIENTATION MUCH MORE PERPENDICULAR TO THE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...WHICH HAS NOT OCCURRED IN THE LAST FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE VERY STRONG 925-800 MB SOUTHERLY FLOW OF 50-60 KT...SEGMENTS OF THE LINE THAT CAN GAIN THIS TYPE OF ORIENTATION WILL QUICKLY GAIN THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE SEVERE WINDS THROUGH DOWNWARD TRANSPORT OF MOMENTUM. FURTHERMORE...THESE BOWING/LEWP SEGMENTS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO DEVELOP MESOVORTICES GIVEN THE STRONG 0-3 KM SHEAR OF 40-5O KT. A RECENT SURGE IN THE LINE IN EVANGELINE COUNTY BEARS WATCHING FOR THIS TYPE OF EVOLUTION. ELSEWHERE...ATTEMPTS AT CONVECTION AHEAD OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE HAVE REMAINED SHALLOW AS EVIDENCED BY THEIR RAPID NORTHWARD ADVECTION IN THE STRONG SOUTHERLY FLOW. THEIR FAILURE TO ANCHOR IN THE DEEPER FLOW TO ATTAIN A MORE RIGHTWARD MOTION IS LIKELY RELATED TO THE MEAGER MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SMALL POSITIVE BUOYANCY ALOFT. CELLS THAT PERSIST AND BEGIN MOVING SLIGHTLY TO THE RIGHT OF THE MEAN FLOW COULD QUICKLY GAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG LOW-LEVEL ROTATION. ALTHOUGH NONE OF THE CELLS CURRENTLY SHOW THIS BEHAVIOR...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY FOR DISCRETE STORMS WITH DEEPER CONVECTIVE CORES. ..CONIGLIO.. 11/17/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY SPREADING TOWARD CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI THIS EVENING MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. A NEW SEVERE WEATHER WATCH MAY BE ISSUED BEFORE THE 02Z EXPIRATION TIME OF TORNADO WATCH 547.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IT IS POSSIBLE THAT RECENT THUNDERSTORM INTENSIFICATION OVER SOUTH CENTRAL LOUISIANA HAS BEEN SUPPORTED BY FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK PERTURBATION EMBEDDED WITHIN THE STRONG CYCLONIC MID/UPPER FLOW FIELDS ACROSS THE WESTERN GULF COAST INTO LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY REGION. SOME ACCELERATION OF THIS CLUSTER /IN EXCESS OF 45 KT...TO THE NORTH NORTHEAST/ HAS OCCURRED DURING THE PAST HOUR...AND ACTIVITY SHOULD PROGRESS INTO AREAS NEAR/JUST SOUTH OF NATCHEZ MS BETWEEN 01-02Z. SUSTENANCE OF CURRENT INTENSITY BECOMES INCREASINGLY UNCLEAR THEREAFTER...AS THIS CLUSTER OR ITS REMNANTS APPROACHES THE JACKSON MS AREA. NORTHEAST OF A MCCOMB/NATCHEZ MS LINE...SURFACE DEW POINTS DROP OFF PROGRESSIVELY FROM NEAR 70 INTO THE MID 60S...AND A CORRESPONDING DECREASE IN MIXED LAYER CAPE FROM WEAK TO NEGLIGIBLE APPEARS TO EXIST. HOWEVER...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT PRECIPITATION LOADING COULD STILL AID THE DOWNWARD TRANSFER OF MOMENTUM ASSOCIATED WITH 40-60+ LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC SOUTHERLY MEAN FLOW TO THE SURFACE IN LINGERING CONVECTION...THROUGH THE 02-04Z TIME FRAME ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI. ..KERR.. 11/18/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE NEAR STRONGER STORMS OVERSPREADING THE REGION THROUGH 07-08Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WHILE ONGOING SQUALL LINE CONTINUES SLOWLY EASTWARD INTO PORTIONS OF CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI AND SOUTHEASTERN LOUISIANA...A NUMBER OF DISTINCT WAVES OF STRONGER CONVECTION HAVE EVOLVED WITHIN THE LINE...AND HAVE BEEN TRACKING NORTH NORTHEASTWARD AT 45-50+ KT. AT LEAST ANOTHER COUPLE IN THE SERIES OF WAVES APPEAR LIKELY TO CONTINUE OVERSPREADING AREAS OF SOUTHEASTERN LOUISIANA...TO THE NORTH OF LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN...AND SOUTH CENTRAL THROUGH CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI...MAINLY SOUTH/THROUGH EAST OF JACKSON...BETWEEN NOW AND 07-08Z. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY WEAK LAPSE RATES AND LIMITED MIXED LAYER CAPE WILL REMAIN MARGINAL FOR SEVERE STORMS. HOWEVER...SEASONABLY HIGH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE CONTENT IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONG TO EXTREME LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...ALONG AN INTENSE SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET AXIS /50-70+ KT AT 850 MB/ SHIFTING EAST OF THE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...MAY CONTINUE TO PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR LOCALIZED DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS...PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO. ..KERR.. 11/18/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES MOVING EWD ACROSS MS/SERN LA. AS STORMS NEAR THE ERN FRINGE OF WW 550...A DOWNSTREAM TORNADO WATCH MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS A SEMI-ORGANIZED BAND OF CONVECTION -- WITH EMBEDDED BOWS AND ROTATING UPDRAFTS -- MOVING EWD ACROSS ERN MS AND SERN LA ATTM. ORGANIZATION OF THE STRONGER/EMBEDDED CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS IS BEING AIDED BY VERY STRONG BACKGROUND SHEAR FEATURING VEERING/INCREASING FLOW WITH HEIGHT AS DEPICTED BY LARGE CLOCKWISE-CURVED HODOGRAPHS ACROSS THE AREA. EXPECT LOCALIZED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO TO CONTINUE AS STORMS CROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW 550 OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. FARTHER E INTO AL...A LOWER-DEWPOINT BOUNDARY LAYER IS BEING REINFORCED BY ESELY WINDS EMANATING FROM THE COLD AIR DAM E OF THE APPALACHIANS. THIS SUGGESTS THAT RETURN OF GULF AIR NWD INTO AL WILL CONTINUE TO BE HINDERED -- AND THUS AN INCREASINGLY SMALL TRIANGULAR-SHAPED ZONE OF SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY WILL REMAIN ACROSS SERN MS AND SWRN AL AS THE CONVECTIVE LINE ADVANCES EWD. THOUGH THIS AREA OF AMPLY MOIST/UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER AIR WILL DIMINISH IN SIZE WITH TIME...SUFFICIENT SEVERE RISK WITHIN THIS AREA MAY WARRANT NEW WW ISSUANCE. ..GOSS.. 11/18/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE/BRIEF TORNADO RISK PERSISTS WITHIN LOW-TOPPED CONVECTIVE LINE. A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO ALSO CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITHIN ISOLATED SHOWERS AHEAD OF THE MAIN CONVECTIVE LINE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A ZONE OF CONVECTION INCLUDING A NARROW/ACTIVE LINE OF STRONGER STORMS AT THE LEADING EDGE CONTINUES MOVING EWD ACROSS ERN MS/WRN AL ATTM. INSTABILITY REMAINS MEAGER AND LOW-TOPPED...WITH MOST OF THE CONVECTIVE TOPS REMAINING BELOW 25000 FT. WITH NO APPRECIABLE MOISTENING/DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED ACROSS THE AREA...ANY LINGERING SEVERE RISK REMAINS DRIVEN BY THE ORGANIZING EFFECTS OF THE VERY STRONG KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THIS AREA. GIVEN THE AMOUNT OF LOW-LEVEL FLOW/SHEAR PRESENT...LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS WITH BOWING SEGMENTS AND/OR A BRIEF TORNADO ARISING FROM TRANSIENT/SMALL-SCALE CIRCULATIONS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE WW AREA. ..GOSS.. 11/18/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
